_note: Two Baidu photos of the apron and terminal at dusk, published alongside the Esri World Imagery satellite view.

yul-baidu-1.webp.en: The apron at Montreal Trudeau at dusk — the terminal's triangular lit facade, with an Air Canada aircraft at a jet bridge.

yul-baidu-2.webp.en: An Air Canada aircraft lifts off at Montreal Trudeau, the 'MONTREAL' control tower behind it.

yul-sat-1.webp.zh: 从卫星图看，蒙特利尔特鲁多国际机场（YUL）的机场布局与周边环境清晰可辨。
